# engine/vendor — third-party code bundled so films run offline
`three.katana.js` = three.js **0.170.0** (r170, MIT → `THREE_LICENSE`) + addons `RoundedBoxGeometry`, `RoomEnvironment`, `BufferGeometryUtils.{mergeGeometries, mergeVertices, toCreasedNormals}` as ONE classic script that sets `window.THREE` (used by `engine/kit/scene3d.js`).
Rebuild in a temp dir OUTSIDE the repo (never commit `node_modules` / `package.json`): `cd "$(mktemp -d)" && npm init -y && npm i --ignore-scripts three@0.170.0 esbuild@0.24.0`, then write `entry.js`:
`import * as CORE from 'three'; import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js'; import { RoomEnvironment } from 'three/addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js'; import { mergeGeometries, mergeVertices, toCreasedNormals } from 'three/addons/utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js'; window.THREE = Object.assign({}, CORE, { RoundedBoxGeometry, RoomEnvironment, mergeGeometries, mergeVertices, toCreasedNormals });`
and run `node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=iife --minify --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/*! three.js r170 … MIT … */" --outfile=three.katana.js`; copy the output here.
